description: This file defines the ZoneService interface, which provides methods for managing Zone entities such as retrieving zones by code, adding descriptions, and fetching zones based on country and language context within the sales manager application.

classes.name: ZoneService
classes.description: An interface extending SalesManagerEntityService for managing Zone entities, providing methods for retrieval and modification of zones and their descriptions.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Zone entity based on its unique code.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a specific zone, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getZones (Country, Language)
methods.description: Fetches a list of zones associated with a specific country and language, throws ServiceException.

methods.name: getZones (Language)
methods.description: Returns a map of zone codes to Zone objects for a given language, throws ServiceException.
